subject: Quick follow-up — Redwood demo + next steps (EOQ check-in)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up — Redwood demo + next steps

Hi Tom —

Great to meet earlier today. Thanks for walking through Acme's realtime insights use case — really helpful to hear where latency and cost are creating friction in production. Quick recap and proposed next steps below so we stay aligned.

Recap
- Current stack: on-prem feature store + cloud-based model endpoints; batch embedding pipeline for enrichment
- Key constraints: 99th percentile latency target of <250ms for interactive queries; unit-cost sensitivity (need to reduce per-token cost for large-scale enrichment)
- Success metric: run 100k inference calls/day with p95 <300ms and a 30% reduction in per-call cost vs current provider

Proposed next steps
1) Pilot scope: 2-week POC using our hosted API with prefix-caching + quantized model variant (sample workload)
2) Technical kickoff: schedule a 30–45m session with your infra lead to confirm traffic profile and KV cache parameters
3) Commercial: I shared a short proposal (attached) with pilot pricing and optional Dedicated estimate if you want an apples-to-apples cost comparison

Can you confirm: (a) budget owner and approval timeline (is this an EOQ decision?), and (b) a good time for the technical kickoff next week? If EOQ is a hard constraint we can fast-track the POC.

Attached: redwood-demo-slides.pdf, redwood-proposal-acme-analytics.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Hey Tom —

Quick bump as we head into the end of the quarter — wanted to check whether priorities/budget for the pilot are still on track for this quarter? I know many teams are reprioritizing right now so totally understand if timelines shifted.

If it helps, we can: 
- Move the technical kickoff to next week and shorten the pilot scope to 1 week to meet EOQ deadlines
- Provide a short written estimate for a minimal pilot and a Dedicated baseline you can take to procurement

Would love a quick thumbs up/thumbs down so we can either lock in resources or schedule for July.

Thanks —
Marissa
From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-30T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — Redwood demo + next steps

Marissa —

Appreciate the follow-up and the clear recap. Short answer: priority has shifted internally and finance has put a temporary freeze on new pilots until they close a couple of contracts — essentially budget timing slipped off the EOQ plan.

That said, the team still likes what we saw in the demo. Can you send a ballpark for (a) 1-week hosted pilot (sample traffic ~100k calls/day) and (b) a Dedicated baseline (reserved capacity) so I can loop in procurement? We should be able to revisit this in early July but I can't promise EOQ approval.

Also — if you have a one-pager showing typical latency/cost wins for a similar customer (real numbers), that would help move procurement faster.

Tom
Principal Product Manager
Acme Analytics

Ballpark (pilot) — Hosted API (1-week, sample ~100k calls/day):
- Pilot fee + support: $8,500 (one-time)
- Estimated token-based usage: ~$2,000–$4,000 for the week depending on prompt length

Ballpark (Dedicated) — Reserved baseline (monthly committed):
- Small pool (suitable for 100k calls/day): $18,000/month committed capacity (24/7, SLA)
- Autoscaling/bursting and ephemeral discounts could apply — we can scope to lower the commit if you want cost protection only during business hours

I'll attach a short one-pager and the slide deck again for procurement. If July works better, can we find 30 minutes next week to walk procurement through the cost model? I have availability: Tue 7/7 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 7/8 14:00–15:00 PT. If none of those work, share a time that does and I will adjust.

I'll also keep the proposed pilot pricing available through July 15 to make it easier for your team to move quickly if approvals come through.
